sections.name: body
sections.value:
Security verdict: BLOCK, reconsidered under C32

PR: #149
Head: 697b6aa0d3eec8fbe9de3926148d6f04b837e15f
Basis: C32 at governance commit62d84336, not a stronger caller-origin requirement.
This is the explicitly requested historical-head reconsideration. Live e0004f8 is not assessed here.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | - | crates/store/src/role_requests.rs; crates/daemon/src/http/requests.rs | 932-965; 129-145, 275-276, 358-359 | C32(3) compliance blocker: request-state mutation commits before mandatory audit | Source-confirmed |

The asserted-owner allowance itself is accepted under C32. S003 is not blocked here merely because local machine-key holders can assert identity.

Condition (2) is met for the specified ID/pane restrictions: contradictory pane/asserted IDs refuse; asserted-only callers get only stored requester/holder authority, never PA/prime. Separate stronger native-origin coverage is not claimed.

Condition (3) is NOT met at697b6aa. The role-request state transaction commits before the handler separately calls audit_close. Audit errors are logged, not rolled back into the state transaction; no matching SQL trigger or transactional request.closed append exists. Cancellation-safe persistence of the request change does not protect the later audit admission. Successful one-event cases do not prove atomicity, failure or cancellation behavior.

The remaining block is audit durability/C32 compliance, not a new caller-strength authentication exploit. Commit the durable audit with the mutation, retaining exactly-once replay semantics, and add failure/cancellation coverage. A later head's changes cannot prove this snapshot.

S004's specific self-role authorization path and S005's state-command formatting remain source-closed. The hostile-holder regression gap at this historical SHA remains qualified; the later e0004f8 delta is separate.

F103 is a separate untrusted-authority-source note, not an automatic149 blocker: current designation was removed from request authorization.

No local builds/tests, role assertions, runtime probes, credential reads or code changes. Original exact-head CI succeeded; this is not a verdict on the current branch.
